items.summary: Generate and add the required Android app icon PNG assets as static files under `frontend/public/assets/generated/` using the exact filenames referenced by the PWA manifest: `android-app-icon.dim_192x192.png` and `android-app-icon.dim_512x512.png`.

Ensure the PWA manifest continues to reference the custom Android icons at `/assets/generated/android-app-icon.dim_192x192.png` and `/assets/generated/android-app-icon.dim_512x512.png`, so the Android TWA wrapper (Bubblewrap/Android Studio flow) uses the custom icon from the manifest.

Update `frontend/ANDROID_TWA_BUILD.md` to explicitly instruct how to package the Android app using the custom icon (Bubblewrap prompt values and the exact icon URLs), and include a short verification checklist confirming the manifest and icon URLs return HTTP 200 before building the APK/AAB.
